verifications.note: EIA natural gas pipeline projects workbook, August 2026 release, row 85 of the Natural Gas Pipeline Projects sheet: MVP Southgate Project, Mountain Valley Pipeline LLC, construction, 31.1 mi of 30 in pipe, 550 MMcf/d
EQT project page for MVP Southgate: about 31 miles of 30 in pipe from the Mountain Valley mainline in Pittsylvania County, Virginia, to Rockingham County, North Carolina, about 550,000 Dth/day
Cardinal News, January 2024: Mountain Valley Pipeline revised MVP Southgate to 31 miles from Pittsylvania County to Rockingham County, North Carolina, down from 75 miles

resolutions.researcher_notes: Possible other name for P2567, Mountain Valley Gas Pipeline (MVP) Southgate Expansion. The August 2026 EIA natural gas pipeline projects workbook lists this project as "MVP Southgate Project", with Mountain Valley Pipeline LLC as operator, 31.1 miles of 30 inch pipe and 550 MMcf/d. The EQT project page and a Cardinal News article from January 2024 describe the same 31 mile line from Pittsylvania County, Virginia, to Rockingham County, North Carolina. Those figures match this row, so it is very likely the same project, but check before accepting. Accepting adds the name to the other English names cell and changes nothing else. The other English names column has no reference column of its own, so the pages that use the name are added to the status reference cell, after the references already there. Pages that use the name: https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx; https://www.mvpsouthgate.com/overview/; https://cardinalnews.org/2024/01/02/mountain-valley-pipeline-revises-mvp-southgate-plans/.
